name: artifacts-e2e-agent-function-seeded-db
body: The Agent and live Function rows the merge joins are seeded directly into the fixture db.lbug because project_fixture's synthetic graph has no Agent or Function node. Limit: these rows are DB-seeded, not scan-derived, so they do not exercise a real scan round-trip. Upgrade if artifacts_e2e ever needs those rows to round-trip through a real scan: switch to a scanned-code fixture.
